"""Minimal re-check: do the agent modules import from a .prototypes script?"""

report = []

try:
    import importlib
    mod = importlib.import_module("text_classification.memory_system")
    report.append(("memory_system", "OK"))
except Exception as exc:
    report.append(("memory_system", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"))

try:
    import importlib
    mod = importlib.import_module(
        "text_classification.agents.label_lexicon_snap_memory"
    )
    report.append(("label_lexicon_snap_memory", "OK"))
except Exception as exc:
    report.append(("label_lexicon_snap_memory", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"))

try:
    import importlib
    mod = importlib.import_module(
        "text_classification.agents.charge_cooccurrence_count_memory"
    )
    report.append(("charge_cooccurrence_count_memory", "OK"))
except Exception as exc:
    report.append(("charge_cooccurrence_count_memory", f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"))

for name, status in report:
    print(f"{name}: {status}")
